_meta.title: New Zealand: police proceedings by ethnicity, by police district, July 2014 - August 2026
_meta.measures: Number of times police proceeded against an alleged offender (by court action, or non-court action such as warnings and diversion), by the person's recorded ethnicity, per police district and fiscal year (July-June). Lets you see the share of proceedings against Maori and Pacific people in each district, and how often each group was sent to court rather than dealt with out of court.
_meta.source: New Zealand Police, policedata.nz 'Proceedings (offender demographics)' - Recorded Crime Offenders Statistics; data extract inside the published Tableau Public workbook 'Offender Proceedings' (table Offenders_Demographic_Public_Tab_E_S_G)

boundaries.source: NZ Police Station Boundaries (NZ Police, published on Koordinates layer 3826, https://koordinates.com/layer/3826-nz-police-station-boundaries/), via ArcGIS Online copy
boundaries.licence_quote: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 New Zealand ... You must attribute the creator
boundaries.note: Stations dissolved into the 12 districts. Based on 2013 Census meshblocks; Chatham Islands station not included (part of Wellington District). Area outlines were not used because area names changed (e.g. Waitemata, Canterbury Rural).

_meta.keys: <ethnicity>_proceedings = all proceedings; <ethnicity>_court / _noncourt / _not_proceeded by method; all_* = all ethnicities. Years are NZ fiscal years (July-June); 2014/15 starts July 2014; 2026/27 is partial (July-August 2026). 'areas' = proceedings by police area inside the district.
notes: Counts are proceedings, not people: one person can be proceeded against several times (NZ Police).
Ethnicity is as recorded by police; 'Not Stated' and 'Organisation' are kept.
No population rates: the source gives counts only. Compare with district population by ethnicity from Stats NZ census if needed.
